title: A Large Sensor Foundation Model Pretrained on Continuous Glucose Monitor Data for Diabetes Management

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's glucose prediction error rates (e.g., rMSE) across different patient age cohorts (18-39, 40-64, and 65+ years old) to ensure demographic robustness.
Evaluating and comparing the predictive accuracy and error rates of the continuous glucose forecasting model between male and female patients.
Assessing prediction performance disparities and generalizability between patient subgroups with different clinical diagnoses, specifically Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) versus Type 2 Diabetes (T2D).
